rows.question: Find all different topics of projects that ended in 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_topic_link AS (
  SELECT
    pt.project::integer AS project,
    pt.topic::text AS topic
  FROM project_topics pt
),
topics_canonical_title AS (
  SELECT
    t.code AS code,
    t.title AS title,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.title, ''), t.code) AS display_title
  FROM topics t
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  t.display_title AS topic_title,
  t.code AS topic_code
FROM projects p
JOIN project_topic_link l ON p.unics_id = l.project
JOIN topics_canonical_title t ON l.topic = t.code
WHERE p.end_date BETWEEN DATE '2014-01-01' AND DATE '2014-12-31'
ORDER BY t.display_title ASC, t.code ASC

rows.question: Find distinct titles of topics of projects that with end year 2014
rows.pred_sql:
WITH project_topics_link AS (
  SELECT
    project_topics.project AS project,
    project_topics.topic AS topic
  FROM
    project_topics
  WHERE
    project_topics.project IS NOT NULL
    AND project_topics.topic IS NOT NULL
),
topics_master AS (
  SELECT
    code,
    rcn,
    title
  FROM (
    SELECT
      t.code::text AS code,
      t.rcn::text AS rcn,
      t.title::text AS title,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.code ORDER BY t.code) AS rn
    FROM topics t
  ) s
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT tm.title
FROM projects p
JOIN project_topics_link ptl ON p.unics_id = ptl.project
JOIN topics_master tm ON ptl.topic = tm.code
WHERE p.end_year = 2014

rows.question: Find the code and title of the funding scheme which funded the highest number of projects.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level_40 AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.ec_fund_scheme
  FROM projects p
),
funding_schemes_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    code,
    title
  FROM funding_schemes
)
SELECT
  f.code,
  f.title,
  COUNT(p.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM projects_row_level_40 p
JOIN funding_schemes_canonical f
  ON f.code = p.ec_fund_scheme
WHERE p.ec_fund_scheme IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.code, f.title
ORDER BY project_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_row_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects p
)
SELECT
  unics_id AS project_id,
  acronym,
  title,
  start_year,
  end_year,
  (end_year - start_year) AS duration_years
FROM projects_row_level
WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  AND (end_year - start_year) = (
    SELECT MAX(end_year - start_year)
    FROM projects_row_level
    WHERE start_year IS NOT NULL
      AND end_year IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY duration_years DESC
